claim.statement: Replit's current Secrets documentation distinguishes App-level and Account-level encrypted environment-variable secrets, requires an Account secret to be linked to an App before use there, and documents role-dependent name and value visibility.

source.title: Secrets — Replit
source.locator: Features; Manage Account Secrets; Managing secrets visibility

values: all deployment types except Static Deployments

limitations: Workspace secret storage and role visibility do not prove which values an Agent task or generated application can access.
unknowns: Secret values, link state, roles, deployment propagation, access logs and Agent access are unknown.
